bullets.text: Southern Railway is awaiting RDSO clearance to rectify the train-platform gap at the newly constructed Adambakkam station, and the office should monitor progress.

stories.title: Train-platform gap yet to be rectified at Adambakkam
takeaways: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix platform gaps at Adambakkam station.
Commuter safety concerns persist until the railway platform modifications are completed.
